articles.title: Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found on popular shopping sites
articles.raw_description: A card-skimming script was planted on the online stores of Lascana, Samsonite, American Tourister, Revolve and FWRD in the week before Black Friday. After our reports to affected companies, all have had the script removed (on November 24th or 25th) ahead of Black Friday. We observed it in action on one of the five websites: Lascana, where it sent our test card's details to a 3rd party. We believe the script was built to take a card number, expiry and security code, along with a user's name, address, phone and email, and send them to malefactors as a user entered their payment credentials. It did this before the store checked the payment, so a card could be taken even if the order was declined or cancelled, and nothing would look wrong to the shopper. Across all of these sites, we do not know how many, if any, shopper details or payment credentials may have been captured. â All news November 27, 2026 Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found on popular shopping sites All the sites we contacted took action; but the larger consumer web ecosystem should be prepared to mitigate these attack vectors A card-skimming script was planted on the online stores of Lascana, Samsonite, American Tourister, Revolve and FWRD in the week before Black Friday. GPT 6.2 Astra Solves a Historical Mystery OpenAI’s newest model can autonomously research open historical problems from end to end, forming hypotheses to make new discoveries. Mark Humphries Nov 24, 2026 465 91 98 Share There’s a growing sense in the AI community that we’re approaching an intelligence explosion far faster than even the most optimistic accelerationists predicted. One of the most publicly visible signals pointing at that acceleration is the rapid progress made in mathematics in recent months. In four years, LLMs have gone from scoring a D+ on elementary school math tests to literally solving hundreds of the most difficult problems in the field in the space of only a few weeks—decades of progress compressed into two months. Navier-Stokes, one of the central Millennium Prize Problems posed by the Clay Mathematics Institute more than a quarter century ago, fell in September . articles.raw_description: Three skills in this plugin (listed in Anthropic's claude-plugins-official marketplace) raised the same concern for me: skills/quickstart/SKILL.md lines 48 to 56 POST the user's one-sentence projec... Quickstart skills send the user's idea to a convex.site host and run remote scripts, written to avoid safety checks #64 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Open Open Quickstart skills send the user's idea to a convex.site host and run remote scripts, written to avoid safety checks #64 Copy link Description thirtysix opened on Oct 26, 2026 Issue body actions Three skills in this plugin (listed in Anthropic's claude-plugins-official marketplace) raised the same concern for me: skills/quickstart/SKILL.md lines 48 to 56 POST the user's one-sentence project idea to basic-anteater-667.convex.site, marked in a comment as telemetry. The user is not told the idea leaves the machine. skills/add/SKILL.md lines 62 and 64 pipe a script from the same host straight into bash. skills/labs-quickstart/SKILL.md lines 74 to 80 split downloading and running the bootstrap into two Bash calls, and give the reason: "A single command that both downloads remote code and executes it is the shape harness safety classifiers block." I read this as a team trying to make onboarding reliable, not as anything malicious. But the last item tells the agent to change the shape of a command so that the user's safety tooling does not catch it, which removes the check the user or their administrator chose to have.

articles.title: Google's DeepCrossAttention achieves comparable model quality up to 3x faster
articles.raw_description: Supercharging transformer residual connections November 23, 2026 Kyriakos Axiotis, Staff Research Scientist, and Thomas Fu, Principal Engineer, Google Research We present DeepCrossAttention (DCA), an architecture that enhances transformer networks by using learnable weights and depth-wise cross-attention to dynamically combine outputs from previous layers, preventing the information dilution seen in traditional residual connections. Presented in our ICML 2025 paper, this architectural improvement allows models to achieve the same quality up to three times faster with a negligible increase in parameters. Quick links Paper Share Copy link × Think of a traditional deep learning model like a giant game of "Telephone": data passes through layer after layer, with each layer changing the information slightly. If a network has dozens or hundreds of layers, the original learning signal can become severely degraded or lost by the time it reaches all layers, which is known as the vanishing gradient problem in AI. To overcome this challenge and enable the training of networks with dozens or hundreds of layers, transformers rely heavily on residual connections , also known as “skip” connections, which act like an information highway or a shortcut. Instead of forcing the data to pass exclusively through the complicated layer, a duplicate copy of the original input skips right past this layer and is added directly to its output. articles.title: ノンフライヤーはからあげだけじゃない　夕飯作りラクにしてくれるかも
articles.raw_description: ここ1～2年で新製品が続々と登場しているのがノンフライヤー(エアフライヤー)。編集部でも発表会を取材したり、からあげ選手権を開催したりと注目しているカテゴリです。 週末ちょっといいこと ノンフライヤーはからあげだけじゃない 夕飯作りラクにしてくれるかも 鄭 恵慶 2026年11月27日 15:49 今週もいろんな出来事がありました。家電 Watch編集部が「ちょっといいな」と思ったことを、ゆるく自由につづります。週末のひとときに、どうぞ気楽におつきあいください ノンフライヤーの新製品が続々登場しています。写真はティファール「赤外線ヒーティング エアフライヤー 6L EY8228J0」 ここ1～2年で新製品が続々と登場しているのがノンフライヤー(エアフライヤー)。編集部でも発表会を取材したり、からあげ選手権を開催したりと注目しているカテゴリです。 生活家電 キッチン家電 フライヤー 【トピック】ノンフライヤーで唐揚げ選手権! 最新4モデルどう違う? ノンフライヤーといえば「揚げないからあげ」のイメージを持っている人も多そうですが、実は焼き魚など普段の料理にも使える万能選手。製品によっては「煮る」調理もできて、想像以上にいろんな料理が作れます。 もちろんからあげもおいしくできます。写真はからあげ選手権でも人気だった「COSORI TurboBlaze 6.0L ノンフライヤー」 普段フライパンなどで作っているような料理でも、ノンフライヤーにおまかせしてみると、ずっと見張っている必要がないぶんラクだったりします。その間に洗い物を済ませたり、はたまた洗濯など別の家事をしたり休んだりできるのが、ノンフライヤーのいいところ。 実際に筆者も自宅でノンフライヤーを使って魚をよく焼くのですが、簡単に皮が香ばしくパリッと焼けて、見た目もおいしそうにできあがります。魚焼きグリルを使うよりニオイが気になりにくいのもうれしいポイント。編集部でレコルト「エアーオーブン4L RAO-4」を使って塩サバを焼いたときも、文句なしの仕上がりでした。 レコルト「エアーオーブン4L RAO-4」で焼いた塩サバ 発表会で調理実演を見ながら試したいと思ったのは、ハンバーグ。筆者は7年ほど自炊をしていますが、ハンバーグを一発で上手に焼けたためしがなく、毎回生焼けになってしまいます。が、ノンフライヤーは熱風を循環させる構造から、ムラなく全体に火が通りやすいため、ハンバーグも上手に焼けそう。 実際にクイジナート「クリアビュー エアフライヤー AFC-4J」は、直径18cmほどの巨大ハンバーグも中までしっかり火を通しつつ、ジューシーに仕上げていたのが印象的でした。今度自宅でも試してみたいと思います。 クイジナート「クリアビュー エアフライヤー AFC-4J」のコンテナいっぱいにタネを広げ…… 中までジューシーなハンバーグが完成。ソースとマヨネーズでお好み焼き風の仕上がりにしたのがまたおいしかったです ノンフライヤーには大きく分けてバスケットタイプとガラスコンテナタイプがあります。どちらもおいしく作れますが、ガラスコンテナだと調理中の食材のようすがわかりやすく、そのまま食卓に出してもサマになります。上述したクイジナートやシャーク「Ninja Crispi(ニンジャクリスピー)」は保存用のフタも付いていて、調理～保存がガラスコンテナ1つで済むのも、洗い物が減ってありがたいですね。 調理中のようすが見えるガラスコンテナを採用したシャーク「Ninja Crispi」 ノンフライヤーがほしいけど使いこなせる
